(2) The shot cuts to an overhead top-down view of the piano keyboard, clearly showing the woman's hands as her fingers strike the keys. The movement is fluid and technical, highlighting the piano's internal mechanisms visible behind the music stand. (3) The camera angle changes to a different side profile, showing more of her upper body and her facial expression as she continues the emotional performance. She is seated on a colorful patterned piano bench. (4) A split-screen effect is introduced: the top half displays her head and shoulders from the side, while the bottom half shows the top-down view of the keyboard and her hands. This continues for the main portion of the musical piece. (5) As the music ends, she pulls her hands back from the keys, turns her head toward the camera with a soft smile, and makes a finger-heart gesture followed by a thumbs-up sign to the viewers.
